newsitem.title: UK: UK wheat futures end thin session lower.
newsitem.headline: UK wheat futures end thin session lower.

text.p: Closing UK wheat futures were lower on a thinly traded market on Tuesday.

Traders said they had expected the market to go lower earlier in the day but after some early losses it crept back up to almost unchanged. By the close wheat was 0.15 to 0.90 stg down while barley ended 0.15 stg up.
"Business is very slow for this time of year, people have tried to build up harvest pressure in the market but cutting has been stop-go and that has not really happened," said a trader.
Turnover was light with 353 lots traded in wheat and 75 lots in barley.
Amsterdam milling wheat futures were neglected for the second day running.
Little activity was reported on the UK cash market with small spot trading reported in the delivered sector and no trade on the fob market.
